label: rem:hoefsmit-binding-amplitude-pion-reading
title: The binding amplitude and the pion decay energy
html:
Read physically, through the Hoefsmit identities, the pion decay \pi \to \mu + \nu de-entangles the meson into V_{(2)} \oplus V_{(1,1)}. It releases a fraction 1 - b^2 = 1/[2]_q^2 of the pion's rest energy:

  E_{\mathrm{bind}} = \frac{m_\pi}{[2]_q^2}.

The residual energy m_\pi \cdot b^2 flows into the de-entangled lepton channel V_{(2)}.

The identification of 1 - b^2 with a fraction of the pion's rest energy is an interpretation; the proposition proves only the two identities.
